name: AgentPeek
soft_passes: #2 reads centred but visual mass is bottom-heavy (bell body) while top flanges push wide toward the safe zone
#4 black-on-white silhouette survives to menu-bar size but eye detail (pupils/sparkles/eyebrows) smears below ~32px
failures: #3 silhouette test: identity lives in the white knockout eyes, which vanish when filled solid black, leaving an ambiguous notch/anvil blob
#10 variant robustness: composition depends wholly on the white ground; black glyph with white-knockout eyes cannot produce Dark/Clear/Tinted renders without an invert/redesign
light_model: soft ambient/top-down; a single diffuse gray drop-shadow halo (~#8C8C93) lifts the flat black glyph off the white tile; eye sparkles imply upper light; glyph body itself unshaded
layer_stack: dark pupils + sparkle highlights + eyebrow arcs (front)
devices: negative-space googly eyes (pupils + pinpoint sparkles + eyebrow arcs)
baked soft-shadow lift on an otherwise perfectly flat glyph
rhymes_hint: flat monochrome mascot icons where a UI element/object is personified with cartoon eyes (the 'cute creature peeking' family) rather than the diagonal-tool or concentric-badge families; also black-glyph-on-white menu-bar/notch utility marks
notes: Resolution: icon.webp is 102x102 with a TRANSPARENT background (glyph-only cutout, not the tile); shipped white-tile composition legible only from cover.jpg (~165px, JPEG). No 1024 master; all hex estimated. Transparent webp hints at possible layered/foreground authoring, but no dark/tinted variant is shown and the white ground is essential, so #10 still fails on evidence. Mask radius unmeasurable. Achromatic by default, not by reserved-accent discipline. Brand-coherent with cover (same icon, grayscale liquid-metal ground, SF-style white wordmark) — the whole brand commits to monochrome. Era-lag: a flat Big-Sur icon shipping in the Liquid Glass era, like 1Password.
